script.cmd: npm start --silent -- remind add "$(date -d '+25 seconds' --iso-8601=seconds)" "Stretch and review the queued approval" && echo __RADD__
npm start --silent -- enqueue "Write today's focus note" && echo __ENQ__
ID=$(npm start --silent -- approvals 2>/dev/null | grep -o "id: '[^']*'" | head -1 | cut -d"'" -f2); npm start --silent -- approve "$ID"
pkill -f "dist/index.js daemon"; sleep 1; npm start --silent -- status | head -10; echo __S__
